player_prompt.intro:
Droeueuh Player {player_id}. Droeueuh meu'main Game Meugang.
Tujuan droeueuh nyan match leubeh lom pair kartu di papan, nibak lawan droeueuh.
Bak giliran droeueuh, piléh duwa kartu keu flip ngon jok beu'et nomor baris ngon kolom kartu phôn ngon kartu keu'dua lagèe '[0 1 1 0]', di mana kartu phôn na di baris 0 ngon kolom 1, ngon kartu keu'dua na di baris 1 ngon kolom 0.
Meunyoë duwa kartu match, droeueuh meu'peunye point ngon kartu tetap meu'hadap ujông. Meunyoë hana match, kartu meu'balék meu'hadap keu'yueh, misa '.'.
Game meu'akhir bak watee pasang kartu meu'keumeukah.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format langkah hana sah. Peunampilan {player_id} hanjeut geu respon deungen arah nyang valid lam kurung peut sagoe.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Gerakan salah. Player {player_id} meu'piléh posisi di luwa' papan.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Gerakan salah. Player {player_id} meu'piléh kartu yang sama dua kali.
invalid_move.already_matched: Langkah hana sah. Peumeu'en {player_id} geupiléh saboh atawa ban dua kartu nyang ka ji peusapat.

game_message.cards_match: Kartu nyang meu'piléh lé Player {player_id} di posisi [{r1} {c1}] ngon [{r2} {c2}] match!
game_message.cards_no_match: Kartu nyang meu'piléh lé Player {player_id} hana match. Kartu di posisi [{r1} {c1}] ngon [{r2} {c2}] nyan {pos1} ngon {pos2} masing-masing.

outcome.draw: Mandua pemain meucocok jumlah pasang kartu yang sama.
outcome.turn_limit: Watee meu'akhir meu'capa'. Game meu'akhir. Player 0 meu'peunye {score_0} point, Player 1 meu'peunye {score_1} point.
